annotation.interpretation_a: The server sends the HANDSHAKE_DONE frame immediately after the last handshake message is constructed and sent, even if the server hasn't fully processed all received handshake messages.
annotation.interpretation_b: The server sends the HANDSHAKE_DONE frame only after it has fully processed all received handshake messages and is confident the handshake has succeeded.
annotation.justification: The phrase 'completes the handshake' is open to interpretation. It's unclear whether it refers to the server finishing *sending* its final handshake message, or finishing *processing* the entire handshake (including validating messages from the client). These two interpretations lead to different implementation behaviors.
annotation.missing_information: The definition of 'completes the handshake' is not precise. Does it refer to the sending of the final handshake message, or the full processing of the handshake?
